purpose: Pin one exact zero-cost local approximately-0.8B-class model artifact candidate for the real loader/model-executor gate without claiming that the bytes have been downloaded, loaded, consumed, inferred, trained, or admitted at runtime.

single_file_role_mapping.role_alias_semantics: The same immutable GGUF container may satisfy two EngineArtifactPaths roles. This does not claim an independently hashed tokenizer subobject; it binds the tokenizer role to the exact container that embeds its tokenizer metadata.

required_promotion_chain: download_or_otherwise_materialize exact artifact bytes on an authorized zero-cost local surface
verify exact artifact SHA-256 and byte count before admission
bind the actual pathname/fd-consuming loader implementation rather than a synthetic callback
witness loader consumption of the exact sealed artifact bytes
admit loader consumption through the existing canonical registry/lease path
admit ModelExecution atomically through canonical MiniUnifiedDB
bind inference receipt and J-Space trace to that exact execution identity
epistemic_note: This file selects and pins a source-level candidate only. FACT_UNKNOWN + METHOD_PRESENT != FACT_PRESENT. Exact upstream artifact metadata does not prove local presence, loader consumption, inference, causality, or training benefit.
